LAW AND MOTION 301, THE MATTER WAS ARGUED. AFTER THE ARGUMENT, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANTS FIESTA MEX LLC (DBA SI SENOR RESTAURANT), ENEIDA FAVELA CORRAL, SALVADOR GULLEN, CESAR CERVANTES, MERCEDES LOZA'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT OR, IN THE ALTERNATIVE, MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS DENIED. THERE IS A TRIABLE ISSUE OF MATERIAL FACT AS WHETHER GOMEZ WROTE THE LETTER AS AN AGENT FOR DEFENDANTS. MS. VILLEGAS WAS ORDERED TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED ORDER IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE PROVISIONS OF CCP SECTION 437(C)G. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL A. KAREN, CSR # 8189 (301/PJB)

LAW AND MOTION 301, THE MATTER WAS ARGUED. AFTER THE ARGUMENT, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT YANETH GOMEZ'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED. THE LETTER IS NOT ABSOLUTELY PRIVILEGED SO CANO CAN ATTEMPT TO SHOW DAMAGE FROM IT AND THERE ARE ACTS OTHER THAN THE LETTER THAT COULD CONSTITUTE RETALIATION BY GOMEZ AS AN AGENT FOR PLAINTIFF'S EMPLOYER. MS. VILLEGAS WAS ORDERED TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED ORDER IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE PROVISIONS OF CCP SECTION 437(C)G. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL A. KAREN, CSR # 8189 (301/PJB)
